details: For every finite binary class, the largest projected one-inclusion average degree is at most its effective range.
proof: Each coordinate projection has effective range at most \mathrm E(\mathcal H), and hence all degrees in its 1-inclusion graph are at most \mathrm E(\mathcal H). Its average degree is at most that value. Maximize over projections.
name: Effective Range / Projected Double Density or Projected Average Degree
